description_en: Retrieves the details of user logs in log management
description_zh: 获取日志管理中用户日志详情
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem get-data-storage --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1130916744880000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDataStorage

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center is located. Specify the management center region based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Your assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: Your assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID that the administrator uses to switch to another member's perspective
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

ColdStorageUsedCapacity.description_en: The cold storage capacity used by user logs
ColdStorageUsedCapacity.description_zh: 用户日志使用冷存储的使用量

DataStorageRegionId.description_en: The storage region of user-side logs
DataStorageRegionId.description_zh: 用户侧日志的存储地域

DataStorageRegionPermission.description_en:
Indicates whether the storage region can be modified. By default, modification is not allowed. Contact the product manager to reset the region. The region can be reset only once. Valid values:
allow: Modification is allowed.
deny: Modification is not allowed
DataStorageRegionPermission.description_zh:
是否可以修改存储地域。默认不可以，联系产品经理可以进行地域重置并且只能重置一次。取值：
allow：可以修改。
deny：不可以修改

DataStorageTotalCapacity.description_en: The storage capacity purchased in the prepaid scenario
DataStorageTotalCapacity.description_zh: 预付费场景下购买的存储用量

DataStorageUsedCapacity.description_en: The storage capacity used in user log management
DataStorageUsedCapacity.description_zh: 用户日志管理中使用的存储量

DataStorageUsedCapacityDetail.description_en: The storage usage details in log management
DataStorageUsedCapacityDetail.description_zh: 日志管理用户使用的存储详情

LogProject.description_en: The name of the Simple Log Service (SLS) project that stores user logs
LogProject.description_zh: 用户日志对应存储的 SLS Project 名称

false: The normalized dataset does not exist

标准化数据集是否存在。取值：
true：存在。
false：不存在

LogDeliveryGroup.description_en:
The group to which the log belongs. Valid values:
host: Host logs.
security: Security logs
LogDeliveryGroup.description_zh:
日志所在的分组。取值：
host：主机日志。
security：安全日志

LogDeliveryPermission.description_en:
Indicates whether you are allowed to toggle the log delivery switch. Log delivery cannot be performed if the service is not purchased. Valid values:
allow: Allowed.
deny: Not allowed
LogDeliveryPermission.description_zh:
是否允许操作日志投递开关，未购买的情况下无法进行投递。取值：
allow：允许。
deny：不允许

LogDeliveryStatus.description_en:
The log delivery status. Valid values:
enable: Log delivery is enabled.
disable: Log delivery is disabled
LogDeliveryStatus.description_zh:
日志投递情况。取值：
enable：开通该日志的投递。
disable：取消该日志的投递

LogDeliveryUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the log delivery was last modified
LogDeliveryUpdateTime.description_zh: 最近一次操作日志投递的时间

LogSearchConditions.description_en: The default log query conditions for the log. When multiple logs are stored in the same Logstore, query conditions are required to perform a log query for a specific log
LogSearchConditions.description_zh: 日志默认查询条件，多个日志存储在一个日志库的时候需要通过查询条件进行单日志查询

LogStoreExisted.description_en:
Indicates whether the Logstore where the log is stored exists. Valid values:
true: The Logstore exists.
false: The Logstore does not exist
LogStoreExisted.description_zh:
日志所在的日志库是否创存在。取值：
true：存在。
false：不存在

LogStoreName.description_en: The name of the Logstore where the log is stored
LogStoreName.description_zh: 日志所在日志库的名字

LogStoreTtl.description_en: The storage duration of the Logstore where the log is stored. Logs are stored for at least 30 days
LogStoreTtl.description_zh: 该日志所在日志库的存储时长，至少存储30天
